caps: You want a flat in Sydney. It's never been sold.
So what's it worth? We priced every flat in the city.
Here's the trick. One clue is never enough,
so we combine them all: past sales, the building, the bedrooms.
We tested it blind, on sales it had never seen.
Seven in ten came within 10%. Nearly double the usual method.
Buyers get a fair price before they bid,
and know a car space adds $84,000.
Banks see which flats are safe to value from a desk,
And it's already priced for this year's dip.
